context: a single passage from a letter by John Lubbock, which you are answering on its own
exchanges: I am indeed sorry to hear so bad an account of you & of your daughter, & hope that change of air may do you both good. Beauy is going on very well, and we now quite hope to save half of the middle joint. It is a sad thing for him.
Many thanks for your interesting note.— I am very glad to hear about your brother. I have several other letters to write & am as idle as a dog, so Farewell | Yours very truly | C. Darwin
